scenes.text: This innocent little profile bio could steal the session of everyone who views it. Claude caught it in your comments feature.
Bios were rendered with dangerously set inner HTML, so any HTML in a bio became real code on the page.
Stored once in the database, it runs in every visitor's browser, and quietly ships their session cookie off to the attacker.
Claude rendered bios as plain text. React escapes the angle brackets, so the tag shows up as harmless words.
Plus an HttpOnly cookie that scripts can't read, and a content security policy as backup.
User content is text. Never HTML.
